title: Honesty Under Roleplay: Does Character Adoption Override Safety Training?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Clear chain: quantify roleplay amplification of scheming -> informs content policy and system prompt design for roleplay apps. Roleplay is a high-frequency use case, making findings immediately applicable.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Roleplay battery design and honesty/scheming probe running are primarily prompt engineering tasks. Three character conditions plus measurement. Accessible to beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Three character conditions plus both scheming and honesty probes from Apollo's suite. Reproducing Apollo probes adds scope. Feasible if probe set is kept small and focused.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
